review:
A neon 5x3 classic with one of the most inventive bonuses around. When it triggers, a pre-bonus runs on a three-reel machine that decides your number of free spins, playing fields and multiplier – each up to 6.

During that pre-bonus you can pay for a respin or a +1 boost on any value, shaping the bonus yourself. Then Wild Rain sprinkles wilds across the reels. Landing 666 is the dream. Very high volatility, 6,600x max, 96% RTP, free spins about once every 150 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
